description: This PHP source file is part of the TestLink open source project. It handles the web interface for viewing, editing, creating, and managing requirements within a requirement specification in the test management system. The script initializes the page, processes user input, manages session and permissions, and renders the appropriate GUI components for requirement editing and management.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes input parameters from the web request, extracting requirement-related IDs and user/session info, and retrieves associated test project data.

methods.name: renderGui
methods.description: Renders the graphical user interface for requirement editing, creation, or deletion, based on the current action and data state, including handling template selection and redirection.

methods.name: initialize_gui
methods.description: Prepares the GUI data structure with requirement specification info, user rights, and interface labels, to be used in rendering the web page.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks that the current user has the necessary permissions to view or modify the requirement data in the context of the project.
